question.en: Discuss the role of the International Bank for Reconstruction and Development (IBRD) in promoting sustainable development in developing nations.
question.hi: Discuss the role of the International Bank for Reconstruction and Development (IBRD) in promoting sustainable development in developing nations.

structure.en: Introduction: Define IBRD and its origin.

introduction.en: The IBRD, established in 1944, is the primary lending arm of the World Bank Group. It was created to support post-war reconstruction and has evolved into a global development institution.
introduction.hi: The IBRD, established in 1944, is the primary lending arm of the World Bank Group. It was created to support post-war reconstruction and has evolved into a global development institution.

body.en: IBRD provides loans, guarantees, and risk management products to middle-income countries. It focuses on long-term development projects in energy, transport, and health. By leveraging capital markets, it provides affordable financing that helps countries build resilient infrastructure and improve governance, which are essential for sustainable growth.

conclusion.en: Through its dual approach of financial support and technical expertise, the IBRD remains a cornerstone in the global effort to eradicate extreme poverty and foster shared prosperity.

valueAddition.en: IBRD maintains a AAA credit rating, allowing it to borrow at low rates and pass those savings to developing nations.
